description: `Distill.main(System.argv())` after a defmodule -> parse error: does not yet parse Upper("Distill") at item position. Elixir .exs files run top-level expressions in order after defining modules. Today every path submits root main/0 (src/compiler2/cli.rs:668,700); AOT build requires main/0. Design question for the proposal page: how script mode sits with the main/0 convention all fixtures use. Three-path parity.
title: Script mode: a file's top-level expressions run in order
